## Introduction

```{r}
L <- matrix(c(4,1, 1, 3), nrow=2, byrow=TRUE)
u <- c(2,-1)
v <- c(3,1)
#i
tL <- t(L)
detL <-det(L)
rankL <- qr(L)$rank
trL <- sum(diag(L))

#ii
isLInvert <- detL != 0
Linv <- solve(L)
 
#iii
Lu <- L%*%u

#iv
eigenL <- eigen(L)
eigenValL <- eigenL$values
eigenVecL <- eigenL$vectors

#v
uTLu <- t(u) %*% Lu

#vi
vuTv <- v %*% (t(u) %*% v)
inProd <- crossprod(u,vuTv) #Check this
```
